# Mika Reyes

> Personal site for Mika Reyes — AI, startups, and life: bio, writing, projects, press, and curated links.

This is the canonical marketing site at https://mikareyes.com. Pages are HTML; there are no parallel `.md` URLs. For a full list of indexable URLs, use the sitemap below.

- **Blog** posts live under `/blog/<slug>` (MDX synced from Notion; source of truth for paths is the published site and sitemap).
- **Projects** and **press** use `/projects/<slug>` and `/press/<slug>` with in-repo content and manifests.
- **Redirects:** `/dreams` → `/my-dreams`; `/more` → `/projects`. Prefer the canonical targets in links and citations.

The homepage expands on current work, prior roles (including Parallax), and featured coverage; start at `/` for the full narrative.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://mikareyes.com/): Bio summary, social/contact grid, and positioning.
- [About](https://mikareyes.com/about): Longer bio and photos.
- [Blog](https://mikareyes.com/blog): Post index; individual posts at `/blog/<slug>`.
- [Projects](https://mikareyes.com/projects): Project index and detail pages.
- [Press](https://mikareyes.com/press): Press index and article/clipping pages.
- [Links](https://mikareyes.com/links): Recommended products and tools.
- [My dreams](https://mikareyes.com/my-dreams): Dreams page (canonical; `/dreams` redirects here).

## Contact and profiles

- [Contact (Letterbird)](https://letterbird.co/mikareyes): Preferred way to reach out.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/itsmikareyes): Professional profile.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/its.mikareyes/): Social.
- [X (Twitter)](https://twitter.com/__mikareyes): Social.
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@its.mikareyes): Short-form video.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://mikareyes.com/sitemap.xml): Exhaustive list of canonical URLs including all blog, project, and press entries.
